info.longBusinessSummary: Core Corporation provides information and communication technology services in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Future Society Solutions Business, Industrial Technology Solutions Business, and Customer Business Integration Business. The Future Society Solutions Business segment engages in social issues such as the environment and life infrastructure. The Industrial Technology Solutions Business provides customers' business problems using IoT (AI), GNSS, and other technologies; and provides solutions that utilize CT technology. The Customer Business Integration Business segment provides total ICT solutions that utilize business knowledge and know-how for customer business. The company offers solutions to public, medical system, energy, Internet of things, media, space technology, DX insight, cloud service, security measures, manufacturing, and finance sectors. Core Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
